item: Row 367 app-ai-tools batch A: AI setup, hero, model store, uninstall, custody status and verify, overlay merge follow a language switch

summary: Fourteen frozen renderers in app-ai-tools.js (loadAiSetup, runAiSetup, loadAiHero, aiStartNow, loadAiStore, migrateOllamaStore, loadAiUninstall, uninstallAi, renderCustodyStatus, custodyGapCheck, viewChain, verifyChain, anchorRoot, overlayMerge) now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml, so a language switch redraws them with no request. A click's state is part of the render (_aiSetupRunning Working, _aiHeroStarting Starting, _aiStoreBusy Copying/Deleting, _aiUninstallBusy Removing); panels written from inside are drawn bare and their parts held. Fix in passing: setup step labels went out untranslated (s.label raw), now t(). Inside held nodes the walker no longer translates, so custody pills go through t(). New keys x12: C1 Signing and C2 Timestamps (labels through the existing frame), C3 'chain intact, signatures valid.' with hover H1 saying the check uses the keys recorded in the log itself (R800: content unchanged, not origin), C4 'keys: {protection}' with the scheme in translate=no, C5 'keys: unreadable', U1 'Uninstall {backend}' (was a weld), M1/M2 labelled migrate counts (were English welds). ja 'verified' corrected from 確認日 (date confirmed) to 検証済み. _gbytes uses the one size writer _fmtBytes.
